verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a token revocation endpoint that handles both refresh and access tokens, and an introspection endpoint that reports whether a token is still active, so server-side revocation can be checked. Admins can manage user sessions, users can manage their own sessions, and single sign-out logs a user out of all applications at once. Missing for 10: documented configuration of session/token expiry (idle and max lifespans), explicit refresh-flow and rotation details, explicit per-session admin revocation via the Admin REST API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
